verdict.rationale: Reflect has an OAuth2 (PKCE-capable) API, but its own docs describe it narrowly: it supports appending data to notes, listing bookmarked links, and 'a few other things.' Deep links add similarly limited actions, such as appending text to the daily note. That falls far short of UI parity, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API coverage of reading, searching, editing and deleting notes; backlinks, tags, publishing, note history and AI features via API; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; independent confirmation of parity.
